interpretation: The 12,000,000 FAE value is a hard ceiling; integer-atom halving truncation schedules 11,999,999.922 FAE absent another rule.
A 180s target increases nominal 20-tx/block capacity relative to 300s with the same block transaction ceiling, but this arithmetic is not a measured throughput result.
Poisson confirmation tails are model outputs; real DAA, propagation, mining participation and outages can widen or distort them.
No deterministic result authorizes a consensus or economic change.
